question: What is the student check-out policy?
answer:
Starting on November 11, 2024, all in-person student checkouts at Vista Ridge High School must occur before 2:45 PM. If you need to check your student out in person, please be aware that you should arrive before this cutoff, as no in-person checkouts are allowed after 2:45 PM. There may be a wait time of about 20 minutes due to construction on campus, which impacts the speed of delivering early dismissal passes and students traveling to the front office.

question: How do I start a new club?
answer:
To start a new club at Vista Ridge High School, follow these steps:

1. Complete the [new club/organization request packet](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1-gTgT9VXpYRzu282hvCj2gJBO5Up-6YIllXjH3F2RZ4/copy).
2. Submit the [online club request packet](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfUHFkxnE59hUt7lz6eDlHG6sNp4Bx14o2VKGETAA-FTKBVVw/viewform?usp=dialog) at the beginning of the year. This is required for both new and returning clubs.
3. If your club will handle money (such as dues or fundraising), review the [Bona Fide Student Club Information and Requirements](https://sites.google.com/leanderisd.org/vrhs-finance/bona-fide-student-club-requirements) and submit a copy of your club's by-laws with your online application.

If you have questions about starting a new club, you should contact Dr. Peabody or Ms. Kelly. You can find their contact information in the [Staff Directory](https://vrhs.leanderisd.org/directory).

Best of luck with your new club!
